report.explanation: Current gateway telemetry (traces, metrics, logs) is healthy and contradicts the alert's premise of elevated error rate and latency, so no bounded root-cause candidate is established. Per policy, healthy telemetry contradicting the hypothesis requires handoff. Missing evidence lists what is needed to substantiate or rule out candidates.
missing_evidence: Gateway telemetry shows healthy state (error_rate 0.0014, p95 77ms, 200 OK); need evidence of the actual error-rate/latency spike the alert claims.
No per-dependency latency or error telemetry for order, inventory, payment, postgresql, or redis to test downstream-latency or db-pool-exhaustion.
No error logs or 5xx spans; need failing request samples to identify http-500 or bad-configuration.
No memory-retention time series for gateway or downstream services to assess memory-leak.
No deployment records to correlate any change with the alert window.
